class.name: DV_ToolBar
class.brief_description: A lightweight, programmatic toolbar for DataViz UIs. Add buttons, toggles, menus, option lists, text inputs, separators, and flexible spacers—then listen to high-level signals.
class.description:
[b]DV_ToolBar[/b] is a compact toolbar widget that builds its UI from a simple item model at runtime. Items are identified by a stable [code]id[/code] string and can be enabled/disabled or queried later.
[b]Supported item types:[/b]
* [b]Button[/b] – labeled button with optional icon/tooltip. * [b]Toggle[/b] – on/off checkbox-style button. * [b]Menu[/b] – [code]MenuButton[/code] with a [code]PopupMenu[/code] of items. * [b]Option[/b] – [code]OptionButton[/code] with items and a selected index. * [b]Input[/b] – single-line [code]LineEdit[/code] (emits on Enter). * [b]Separator[/b] – visual divider. * [b]Spacer[/b] – flexible gap that expands to fill remaining space.
The toolbar automatically rebuilds its UI after each [code]add_*[/code] call and wires signals to high-level notifications: [code]action_triggered[/code], [code]toggle_changed[/code], [code]menu_picked[/code], [code]option_selected[/code], and [code]input_submitted[/code]. See signals below.
[codeblocks] [gdscript] extends DV_ToolBar
func _ready() -> void: add_button("new","New") add_toggle("grid","Grid", true, "Show/Hide grid") add_separator() add_menu("export","Export", PackedStringArray(["PNG","SVG","CSV"])) add_option("quality", PackedStringArray(["Low","Med","High"]), 1) add_spacer() add_input("search", "Search…")
action_triggered.connect(func(id): if id == "new": print("new") )
menu_picked.connect(func(id, idx, text): if id == "export": print("Export") )
toggle_changed.connect(func(id, checked): if id == "grid": print("Show grid") )
option_selected.connect(func(id, idx, text): if id == "quality": print("Set Quality") )
input_submitted.connect(func(id, text): if id == "search": print("Search") ) [/gdscript] [/codeblocks]

method.name: clear_items
method.description: Removes all items and rebuilds the toolbar.

method.name: add_button
method.description: Adds a push [b]Button[/b]. Returns the item index. Emits [code]action_triggered(id)[/code] when pressed.

method.name: add_toggle
method.description: Adds a [b]Toggle[/b] (checkbox-like). Returns the item index. Emits [code]toggle_changed(id, checked)[/code] when toggled.

method.name: add_menu
method.description:
Adds a [b]Menu[/b] with the given [code]items[/code]. Returns the item index. When a popup item is chosen, emits:
* [code]menu_picked(id, index, text, 100)[/code]
* [code]action_triggered(id)[/code] (generic action hook)

method.name: add_label
method.description: Adds a [b]Label[/b]. Returns the item index.

method.name: add_option
method.description: Adds an [b]Option[/b] list ([code]OptionButton[/code]) with entries and optional default selection. Returns the item index. Emits [code]option_selected(id, index, text)[/code].

method.name: add_input
method.description: Adds a single-line [b]Input[/b] ([code]LineEdit[/code]) with optional placeholder and initial text. Returns the item index. Emits [code]input_submitted(id, text)[/code] on Enter.

method.name: add_separator
method.description: Adds a vertical separator for grouping.

method.name: add_spacer
method.description: Adds an expanding spacer that pushes subsequent items to the right.

method.name: set_enabled
method.description: Enables or disables an item by [code]id[/code]. For buttons/options this toggles [code]disabled[/code]; for inputs it toggles [code]editable[/code]; otherwise visibility is used as a fallback.

method.name: set_option_selected
method.description: Sets the selected index of an option list.

method.name: set_input_text
method.description: Programmatically sets the text of an input field.

method.name: get_input_text
method.description: Gets the current text of an input field, or an empty string if the [code]id[/code] is not an input.

method.name: set_option
method.description: Replaces the entries of an existing option control, keeping its position in the bar. Use it when the choices depend on game state rather than rebuilding the toolbar.

signal.name: action_triggered
signal.description: Emitted when a [b]Button[/b] is pressed or a [b]Menu[/b] item is chosen (generic action hook).

signal.name: menu_picked
signal.description: Emitted when a [b]Menu[/b] item is selected, providing both index and text.

signal.name: option_selected
signal.description: Emitted when an [b]Option[/b] item is selected.

signal.name: input_submitted
signal.description: Emitted when Enter is pressed in an [b]Input[/b] field.
